- Windows and storefront windows (if applicable): keep glass haze-free for a welcoming storefront and interior visibility.
- Drains/power washing: not typically required for clinics; focus on sanitary management instead.
- Compliance and safety: regular sanitization supports patient safety and regulatory compliance.
